answer_result.answer: Dave likes classic cars the most; he says he is obsessed with classic cars, loves their design and engineering, and finds they have a unique charm.

question.question: Which types of cars does Dave like the most?

evidence_items.text:
Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo.
[Image caption: a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it]
[S4T1] (dia_id: D4:1)

Calvin: Wow Dave! Congrats on opening your own car maintenance shop! It looks like all your hard work and dedication paid off.
[Image caption: a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage]
[S4T2] (dia_id: D4:2)

Dave: Thanks, Cal! It's great to see my hard work paying off. Opening this shop was my dream, and I'm really happy to see it getting started. It was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it.
[S4T3] (dia_id: D4:3)

Calvin: Woo, Dave! Congrats on achieving your dream - you've got guts and ambition - that's awesome! Keep it up!
[Image caption: a photo of a book with a space theme on it]
[S4T4] (dia_id: D4:4)

Dave: Thanks! Appreciate the support. My dream was to open a shop and it's a step towards my other dream of working on classic cars. I love their design and engineering.
[S4T5] (dia_id: D4:5)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! Going for it with classic cars is cool! Fulfilling your dreams is so important.
[Image caption: a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot]
[S4T6] (dia_id: D4:6)

Dave: I'm obsessed with classic cars. They have a unique charm. I was so thrilled to restore one last year—nothing like bringing it back to life! Take a look at the engine of the restored car.
[Image caption: a photo of a car engine with a small air filter]
[S4T7] (dia_id: D4:7)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! That looks awesome!
[S4T8] (dia_id: D4:8)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It was a labor of love. Challenging, but so worth it.
[S4T9] (dia_id: D4:9)

Calvin: Yeah, it's awesome when you see something you worked on come to life.
[S4T10] (dia_id: D4:10)

Dave: Yeah! It feels great to see the hard work pay off, it's like bringing something back to life.
[S4T11] (dia_id: D4:11)

Calvin: Yeah, it's an amazing feeling when you create something and it resonates with people. It's so satisfying when you finish something you made from scratch!
[S4T12] (dia_id: D4:12)

- Friend/acquaintance of Calvin; was congratulating Calvin on his new home, following up on his plans to go to Japan, and asking how long Calvin will stay (see /memories/calvin.md) as of 2023-03-23 [S1T4][S1T8][S1T14][S1T16].
- On 2023-03-26, congratulated Calvin on his new luxury car [S2T2][S2T6]; later that day asked Calvin what's new in his life after their talk about the festival and his favorite band [S2T16].
- On 2023-03-26, looking forward to hearing Calvin's new tunes and asked him to keep him updated on his collaborations [S2T18][S2T20].
- On 2023-04-20, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see"), who reported back from a Tokyo music festival; Dave reacted enthusiastically and asked what Calvin learned and where he sees his music taking him [S3T1][S3T2][S3T4][S3T6][S3T8].
- On 2023-05-31, caught up with Calvin ("been ages since we chatted"); congratulated Calvin on the Frank Ocean tour (Tokyo stop; details in /memories/calvin.md) [S7T1][S7T2]. Shared a photo of himself fixing a neighbor's car engine in a garage (details in ## Car maintenance shop) and told Calvin that working on cars is "definitely therapeutic"; Calvin said fixing cars calms him down "like meditating" and asked whether Dave has hobbies with the same satisfaction — Dave described his passion for fixing up things as more than a hobby, giving purpose and a sense of achievement (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S7T2][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6]. The exchange ended with the two agreeing that transforming something and giving it a new life makes them feel like they "really achieved something" [S7T7][S7T8]. The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed the "feeling of power and happiness" ("It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas") [S7T9]; Dave asked whether Calvin always enjoys performing live (Calvin: it "always fuels my soul" — an "absolute high") [S7T10][S7T11], and Dave marveled at the artist-audience connection and the concert crowd photos Calvin shared (a large crowd taking pictures; a crowd watching a concert with bright lights; a band on stage), calling the atmosphere "off the charts" and saying music "brings people together ... like therapy for us all" [S7T12][S7T13][S7T14]; when Dave asked what's next for Calvin's music, Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour, and Dave said he'll be there to cheer him on (details in ## Boston) [S7T14][S7T15][S7T16]. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished Calvin a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-04-20, continued the catch-up: offered to show Calvin around Boston (Paradise Rock, House of Blues, Fenway Park), said he'll be in the front row when Calvin performs, and agreed to grab food at his favorite spots when Calvin visits (details in ## Boston) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16]. Calvin shared a photo of his red sports car on display at a show, and Dave praised the work put into it [S3T13][S3T14].
- On 2023-05-01, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see") and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop — a dream come true and a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars; shared a photo of the shop (including a group of people in front of a car) and of the engine of the classic car he restored in 2022, and invited Calvin to come by; Calvin congratulated him, the conversation closed with mutual encouragement, and Calvin shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (details in ## Car maintenance shop, ## Classic cars, and /memories/calvin.md) [S4T1][S4T5][S4T7][S4T15][S4T16][S4T17][S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].
- On 2023-05-01, complimented Calvin's necklace and asked where he got it (Calvin: a gift from another artist, a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician); encouraged Calvin to keep pushing and making music, and the two agreed to keep each other motivated — "the road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going" (in Calvin's words) [S4T25][S4T26][S4T27][S4T28].

Calvin: Hey Dave, long time no see! I just took my Ferrari for a service and it was so stressful. I'm kinda attached to it. Can you relate? What kind of hobbies give you a feeling of being restored?
[S12T1] (dia_id: D12:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin, I understand the stress of getting a car serviced. Fixing cars is like therapy for me. Growing up working on cars with my dad, refurbishing them gives me a sense of fulfillment.
[S12T2] (dia_id: D12:2)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's awesome! Must feel great to have a hobby that makes you proud. Remember any good memories from working on cars with your dad?
[S12T3] (dia_id: D12:3)

Dave: Yeah, definitely! I have fond memories of working on cars with my dad as a kid. We spent one summer restoring an old car. It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying.
[S12T4] (dia_id: D12:4)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Working together on projects like that really brings people closer. Do you have any pictures from that time?
[S12T5] (dia_id: D12:5)

Dave: Yes, I have one, take a look. It was a wonderful experience.
[Image caption: a photography of a man and a child pose for a picture]
[S12T6] (dia_id: D12:6)

Calvin: Aww, that's cool, Dave. Reminiscing is always fun! That pic you shared takes me back to my trip to the Ferrari dealership. I saw a lot of amazing cars, but as for me, my car is the best and  I'm pretty proud of this. Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication. It really inspires me. Take a look at this beauty!
[Image caption: a photography of a red car is lifted on a lift in a garage]
[S12T7] (dia_id: D12:7)

Dave: Your car looks great, Calvin! I can tell why you're proud. Having something like that is motivating. It's like a reminder of what you can achieve.
[S12T8] (dia_id: D12:8)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Seeing it everyday keeps me motivated and reminds me to keep pushing.
[S12T9] (dia_id: D12:9)

Dave: Sounds like you're really motivated, Calvin. What's the biggest goal you're working towards, music-wise or something else?
[S12T10] (dia_id: D12:10)

Calvin: My plan for now is to expand my brand worldwide and grow my fanbase. I want my music to reach more people and make an impact. Working with artists from around the globe and challenging myself to create special music are goals of mine too. Look at the photo of how I performed with the boys last night, they are great at the music!
[Image caption: a photo of a band playing on stage with lights on]
[S12T11] (dia_id: D12:11)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Working with different artists and crafting great sounds will definitely help you reach your goals. Keep it up and keep making a difference!
[S12T12] (dia_id: D12:12)

- The 2023-06-09 conversation continued: Calvin asked what was new and exciting for Dave, and Dave announced he booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023) — "finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks" (details in ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T10]. Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to escape it all and de-stress — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S8T9]. The two exchanged trip wishes and signed off "see you soon" [S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin told Dave about a car accident he had on 2023-06-16 (no one hurt); Dave expressed sympathy, asked whether the insurance process had any issues and how long it took to sort out, and asked about the mechanic in Calvin's garage photo. Details of the accident and repair are in /memories/calvin.md > ## Car accident (2023-06-16) [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].
- On 2023-06-21 (continuing the car-repair conversation), Dave said it's awesome that Calvin trusts the people fixing the car — "Sounds like they're doing a great job. It'll be back to normal soon!" [S9T10].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin then shared a photo of a small-town view in Japan with a mountain in the background; Dave marveled at it — "I haven't seen anything like that before!" — asked where it was and whether Calvin has been there; Calvin said not yet, but it's on his to-do list for after the Frank Ocean tour — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Japan plan [S9T11][S9T12][S9T13][S9T14][S9T15].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin shared a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain ("Look at that snowy peak"); Dave asked whether Calvin has ever tried skiing before, and Calvin answered that he hasn't tried it, but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might give it a try once — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S9T15][S9T16][S9T17].

Dave: Cool, Calvin! Art is amazing how it reflects the world. Has anything caught your eye lately and made an impact on your music?
[S25T9] (dia_id: D25:9)

Calvin: Yeah, for sure! Recently, I've been really inspired by some of the struggles that people go through. It's made me dig deeper into my music to try to capture those feelings.
[S25T10] (dia_id: D25:10)

Dave: That's cool. Using your music to share experiences and feelings, is it cathartic for you?
[S25T11] (dia_id: D25:11)

Calvin: Yeah, it's a way for me to express myself and work through my emotions. It's like my own form of therapy.
[S25T12] (dia_id: D25:12)

Dave: Yeah, I get it. Cars give me an outlet to express myself. It's like a little oasis of calm. Whenever I'm working on one, it's like I'm connecting back with myself. And yeah, the music helps too! Look at my garage, a little dirty, but everything is in its place.
[Image caption: a photography of a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall]
[S25T13] (dia_id: D25:13)

Calvin: Looking cool - what made you start working on cars?
[S25T14] (dia_id: D25:14)

Dave: Ever since I was ten, I've been fascinated with how machines work. I found an old car in a neighbor's garage and asked if I could fix it. That's when my love for car engineering began! I enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made me hooked—so I've been working on cars ever since.
[Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car in a garage]
[S25T15] (dia_id: D25:15)

Calvin: Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life. Was it a classic car? Do you still have it or are you currently working on another project?
[S25T16] (dia_id: D25:16)

Dave: Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector. Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge! Take a look at this wonderful car!
[Image caption: a photo of a black car parked in a parking lot]
[S25T17] (dia_id: D25:17)

Calvin: Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?
[S25T18] (dia_id: D25:18)

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text:
- Can't wait to show Calvin some cars when he comes to Boston [S3T12].
- "Obsessed with classic cars" — they have a unique charm; he loves their design and engineering [S4T5][S4T7].
- Restored a classic car in 2022 ("last year" as of 2023-05-01); thrilled by it — "nothing like bringing it back to life" — and shared a photo of the restored car's engine (with a small air filter) [S4T7].
- On 2023-05-03, stated his dream is to someday build a custom car from scratch; plans to keep learning more about auto engineering to get there [S5T5].
- On 2023-07-21, said the road trip reminded him "why I love cars so much", and that reconnecting with his passion "reminded [him] why [he's] passionate about what [he] does" and makes his long working hours worth it [S11T1][S11T3].

Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no talk! Got some cool news to share - last night was a blast! My band and I were jamming and the music just kept flowing. We had so much fun rehearsing! Also, last weekend, I had the opportunity to attend a rock concert here in Boston. Just take a look at what an amazing atmosphere it was!
[Image caption: a photography of a band performing on stage with bright lights]
[S19T1] (dia_id: D19:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! That's awesome! When everything just clicks during a jam session, it's such a great feeling. Do you happen to have any recordings of those sessions? That sounds fantastic! Rock concerts always have such an electrifying atmosphere! 
[S19T2] (dia_id: D19:2)

Dave: Hey Calvin! I wish we had recorded the jam, but we were way too into it and totally forgot.
[S19T3] (dia_id: D19:3)

Calvin: Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music. Oh well, some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio. It's like those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds. Take a look at this cool Disney poster!
[Image caption: a photo of a poster for a disney movie with a chef]
[S19T4] (dia_id: D19:4)

Dave: Wow, that's a gorgeous poster! It reminds me of one of my favorite Disney movies. I love the lesson it teaches about following your dreams no matter what others say. Have you seen it yet?
[S19T5] (dia_id: D19:5)

Calvin: Thanks! Ratatouille is one of my favorites! It's all about going after what you love, no matter what anyone says. Last time we talked, you mentioned your car hobby - how's that going?
[S19T6] (dia_id: D19:6)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It's been awesome. Been restoring this vintage beauty - here is the final result pic, take a look!
[Image caption: a photography of a man standing next to a classic car]
[S19T7] (dia_id: D19:7)

Calvin: Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?
[S19T8] (dia_id: D19:8)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life, especially with people's reactions when they see the finished product - makes all the hard work worth it.
[S19T9] (dia_id: D19:9)

Calvin: Dave, it's awesome seeing people happy thanks to you! Fixing cars is such an art. You're inspiring - keep up the good work!
[S19T10] (dia_id: D19:10)

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-11, got picked for a car mod workshop — called it "a dream come true", since he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car (ties to his stated dream of building a custom car from scratch, see ## Classic cars); Calvin congratulated him [S13T1][S13T3].
- Shared a photo of himself standing in front of a car on a lift at the workshop [S13T1].
- Shared a photo of the "really thrilling part of the workshop" — a mechanic working on a car — saying "seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying" [S13T5].

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! This is a dream come true for me, as I've always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car.
[S13T3] (dia_id: D13:3)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Pursuing your passion for auto engineering and making a custom car is a great experience. I'm excited to see what you create. Keep it up and have fun every step of the way. What do you think is the most thrilling part of it?
[S13T4] (dia_id: D13:4)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I've found the picture with really thrilling part of the workshop, take a look. Seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying.
[Image caption: a photo of a car is being worked on by a mechanic]
[S13T5] (dia_id: D13:5)

Calvin: Wow, that sounds like a fulfilling hobby! What kind of transformations have you done so far? How's it going with the current project?
[S13T6] (dia_id: D13:6)

Dave: I've been working on this car, doing engine swaps and suspension modifications. Now I'm learning about body modifications. Giving this classic muscle car a modern twist is a challenge but so fun!
[Image caption: a photo of a silver corvette parked in front of a building]
[S13T7] (dia_id: D13:7)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that looks cool! The silver finish gives it a modern twist. Great job!
[S13T8] (dia_id: D13:8)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Yeah, I wanted a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style. Really happy with it!
[S13T9] (dia_id: D13:9)

Calvin: You've really put in some work! That attention to detail is great.
[S13T10] (dia_id: D13:10)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It's all about those small details that make it unique and personalized.
[S13T11] (dia_id: D13:11)

Calvin: Yeah, customizing a masterpiece with those small details is what makes it unique and personalized.
[S13T12] (dia_id: D13:12)

Dave: Yeah! It's about showing my style, it's like customizing a work of art on wheels.
[S13T13] (dia_id: D13:13)

Calvin: No problem, Dave. Your enthusiasm and hard work show in everything you do. Keep coming up with new cool stuff, bud. I'm excited to see what you'll do next.
[S13T14] (dia_id: D13:14)

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Car workshops in San Francisco
evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-14, told Calvin he got to go to a car workshop in San Francisco — "So cool to dive into the world of car restoration and see all the different techniques"; the people there were "really passionate and dedicated" — "truly inspiring!" [S14T1]. (Related to his car passion and auto engineering, see ## Classic cars)
- On 2023-09-02, said he's been "tied up with car stuff lately" and that he came back from a (second) trip to San Francisco the day before (2023-09-01) with "some great insights and knowledge on car modification" that he wanted to share with Calvin — he finds "changing things around, and giving an old car a new life" "so satisfying!" (A separate trip from the 2023-08-14 workshop visit above.) [S17T1]

Dave: Wow, Calvin, sounds amazing! Got any pictures from that show? Would love to see the atmosphere.
[S14T7] (dia_id: D14:7)

Calvin: Yeah, here's a pic I took. It was so awesome - I loved how the crowd was into it. These moments are why I love my job.
[Image caption: a photography of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands up]
[S14T8] (dia_id: D14:8)

Dave: The energy in that pic is awesome! Seeing everyone with their hands up must have been really cool. It's great when your passion brings joy to others!
[S14T9] (dia_id: D14:9)

Calvin: Yeah, that was buzzing! It's moments like these that make me so proud and motivated. I'm all about spreading joy with my art. So, how's your project going?
[S14T10] (dia_id: D14:10)

Dave: Yeah, the project is going great! Here's a pic of the car I'm restoring. It's pretty cool seeing it go from a beat-up mess to a real beauty.
[Image caption: a photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods]
[S14T11] (dia_id: D14:11)

Calvin: Wow Dave, that car is going to look amazing when you're done. How long do you think it will take to restore it?
[S14T12] (dia_id: D14:12)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Fingers crossed it'll be all fixed up by the end of next month. Lots of elbow grease but it'll be worth the transformation.
[S14T13] (dia_id: D14:13)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, I'm really excited to see the end result of your hard work! You've got some serious talent!
[S14T14] (dia_id: D14:14)

Dave: Thanks, Cal! Your support means a lot to me.
[S14T15] (dia_id: D14:15)

Calvin: You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you. Seeing your enthusiasm is amazing. Keep growing, buddy. It'll be worth it! Good luck with that. See ya!
[S14T16] (dia_id: D14:16)
